svg.title: AlgoGalaxy: An online judge that runs untrusted code safely. Process-isolated sandboxes: Linux namespaces and per-submission resource limits. Redis token-bucket rate limiting and result caching. Admin, Moderator and User roles with moderated problem contributions. Dockerized behind Nginx on AWS EC2.
